description.p: Y2038 safe lastlog database implementation, PAM module.

maintainer-scripts.postinst: # Adds pam_lastlog2 to /etc/pam.d/common-session. libpam-runtime only # brings pam-auth-update along on the target system. if [ -x "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/pam-auth-update" ]; then "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/pam-auth-update" --package fi
